About Purvey

Good tools should be within reach.

We’re building Purvey so more Nigerian businesses can sell online and manage their everyday work, without the cost of a custom ecommerce website.

The story behind Purvey

Our story

Why we built Purvey.

At Secern, businesses came to us for ecommerce websites. Some were ready to take their next step online, but the quotation put a custom website out of reach.

Meanwhile, people around us were already selling through social media and virtual stores. They needed a place for their products and a way to manage the work behind each sale. We also saw how difficult setting up online payments could be for small businesses.

We built Purvey so businesses could use one platform, each with their own storefront and tools, at a more accessible cost. A place to sell, keep records and manage the day’s work—without commissioning a website from scratch.

Our values

What matters to us.

Make access affordable.

A custom website shouldn’t be the only route to selling online. We keep a Free plan alongside paid options, so businesses can start with what they need.

Keep it easy to use.

Business owners should be able to add a product, update stock or check an order themselves. We aim to make that everyday work straightforward.

Build around real work.

We focus on the jobs merchants already do: selling products, managing orders and looking after customers. Those needs guide what we build.

Be clear with merchants.

Pricing, plan limits and payment requirements should be easy to understand. We want business owners to know what to expect before they commit.

Our purpose

Make running a business easier.

Useful commerce tools should be easier to access and easier to use. That’s what we’re working towards with Purvey.

Whether you’re just starting, already selling on WhatsApp or Instagram, or running an established business, Purvey gives you a storefront and one place for products, stock, orders, customers and payment records.
